summary: Russia conducted a multi-axis aerial assault on Ukrainian infrastructure overnight, involving barraging munitions designated "Banderоль," jet drones, cruise missiles, and KAB guided bombs across Kharkiv, Poltava, Sumy, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, Odesa, and Mykolaiv oblasts. Ukrainian forces struck back deep into Russia, hitting the Ryazan Oil Refinery (Rosneft) and the Adler airport in Sochi, reportedly destroying Ka-52 and Mi-28 helicopters and damaging an Mi-8. Concurrently, US envoys Witkoff and Kushner held separate talks in Moscow and Kyiv, with Witkoff claiming significant progress on a "peace package" while the Kremlin signaled it sees military advantage and will not abandon its war aims.
key_points: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner conducted parallel talks in Moscow with Putin and separately in Kyiv with Zelensky on an updated Ukraine settlement package (Source: @tass_agency/394079).

Ukrainian forces struck the Ryazan Oil Refinery (Rosneft, ~17 million tons/year capacity) and Adler airport in Sochi, reportedly destroying Ka-52, Mi-28 helicopters and damaging an Mi-8 (Source: @eRadarrua/111093).

Russia launched barraging munitions ("Banderоль"), jet drones, cruise missiles, and KABs across at least nine oblasts; Lubny was hit directly by cruise missiles and drones causing house strikes (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73782).
In Chuhuiv, Kharkiv oblast, a Russian attack killed almost an entire family: a 19-year-old girl, 11-year-old boy, and 45-year-old man; a 40-year-old woman was wounded (Source: @UkraineNow/83912).

The Kremlin told the US delegation it sees no reason to abandon its military goals in Ukraine, citing perceived battlefield progress and demanding increasingly tough conditions (Source: @UkraineNow/83918).
Air raid was declared in Kyiv; ballistic Iskander-M threats were issued from Taganrog (Rostov oblast) and Kursk oblast, with S-300/Zircon also threatened (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73799).
Two cruise missiles ("Banderоль") bypassed Romny district of Sumy heading to Pryluky, Chernihiv oblast, indicating strikes targeting Kyiv region infrastructure (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73789).
DeepStateUA confirmed Russian forces advanced near Kostiantynivka on the eastern front (Source: @DeepStateUA/23807).

sections.executive_summary: Russia executed a coordinated multi-axis aerial campaign overnight, striking at least nine Ukrainian oblasts with barraging munitions, jet drones, cruise missiles, and KAB bombs, while threatening ballistic Iskander-M launches from Taganrog. Ukraine retaliated deep into Russian territory, striking the Rosneft-owned Ryazan Oil Refinery and the Adler military helicopter base in Sochi. In parallel, US envoys Witkoff and Kushner shuttled between Moscow and Kyiv pursuing an updated settlement package, but the Kremlin publicly maintained it sees military advantage and will not abandon its stated war aims.

points: Ukrainian Air Force reported widespread barraging munition and drone activity across the entire country, with "Banderоль" munitions tracked from Sumy toward Chernihiv, then to Brovary and Boryspil districts of Kyiv oblast, indicating a deliberate targeting pattern against the capital region. (Source: @kpszsu/76816)

In Chuhuiv, Kharkiv oblast, a Russian attack killed almost an entire family: a 19-year-old girl, an 11-year-old boy, and a 45-year-old man; a 40-year-old woman was wounded, according to UkraineNow. (Source: @UkraineNow/83912)

Lubny in Poltava oblast suffered a targeted strike: first a downed jet drone reportedly hit residential houses, followed by cruise missile impacts confirmed by mon1tor_ua, who reported two direct hits in the city. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73785)

In Dnipro, a Russian strike on civilian logistics infrastructure wounded two people of varying severity, according to the Oblast Military Administration as reported by eRadarrua. (Source: @eRadarrua/111110)
In Dnepropetrovsk, a series of explosions caused fires at warehouses of a logistics company following a Russian attack, per ukr_leaks_eng. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33051)
The Orlovka checkpoint on the Romanian border in Odessa oblast suspended operations due to attacks on border infrastructure, disrupting a key western logistics route. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33043)

MP Kostenko publicly promised there will be no forced mobilization of women in Ukraine, framing it as an artificially hyped issue and stating defense responsibility rests with men. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33044)

Ukrainian forces struck the Ryazan Oil Refinery (Rosneft, ~17 million tons/year design capacity), one of Russia's largest refineries, which plays a key role in fueling Russian occupation forces. (Source: @eRadarrua/111093)

Ukrainian forces struck the Adler airport in Sochi, identifying destroyed Ka-52 and Mi-28 attack helicopters on the military apron and a damaged Mi-8, per eRadarrua citing CyberBoroshno. (Source: @eRadarrua/111103)

eRadarrua reported a Tu-95MS strategic bomber redeployed from the Far East to Engels airbase for cruise missile loading, with evening redeployment planned to Olenya, the second such flight this week; five more Tu-95MS remain armed in the Far East, indicating preparation for a massive missile strike at week's end. (Source: @eRadarrua/111094)

Per TASS citing the Energodar mayor, the AFU conducted a repeat strike on the market in Energodar, with the first strike having wounded six people, signaling deliberate targeting of occupied Zaporizhzhia oblast urban sites. (Source: @tass_agency/394050)

The Kremlin signaled to US envoys it sees no reason to abandon military goals in Ukraine, citing perceived battlefield progress and increasingly tough demands; Putin advisor Ushakov confirmed Russia's confidence in achieving its stated aims. (Source: @UkraineNow/83918)

DeepStateUA confirmed on its updated map that Russian forces advanced near Kostiantynivka, a key logistics hub in Donetsk oblast north of the main Russian push toward the Pokrovsk axis. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23807)

Russian tactical aviation activity was reported on the eastern axis by the Ukrainian Air Force, with warnings issued of imminent use of aerial strike weapons against frontline oblasts. (Source: @kpszsu/76870)

eRadarrua tracked a jet drone moving from Donbas southward into Zaporizhzhia oblast, indicating sustained aerial ISR/strike missions along the southern Donetsk-Zaporizhzhia border zone. (Source: @eRadarrua/111087)

TASS reported that Russian Armed Forces struck objects of transport and logistics infrastructure of the AFU, consistent with ongoing interdiction operations in the operational zone. (Source: @tass_agency/394077)

mon1tor_ua tracked two "Banderоль" cruise missiles bypassing Romny district of Sumy oblast heading toward Pryluky, Chernihiv oblast, then further toward Kyiv region, targeting Brovary and Boryspil districts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73789)
Two "Banderоль" munitions bypassed Obukhiv/Ukrainka heading toward Vasylkiv, a key southwestern Kyiv region settlement near critical military airfields, per mon1tor_ua. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73793)

kpszsu reported a "Banderоль" loitering munition heading toward Novi Sanzhary in Poltava oblast from the northeast, while another targeted Hadiach from the northeast, suggesting a coordinated strike package against central Ukrainian infrastructure. (Source: @kpszsu/76841)
eRadarrua tracked "Banderоль" munitions bypassing Sribne on Chernihiv oblast axis toward Kyiv and a separate "Banderоль" toward Nosivka with course on Brovary. (Source: @eRadarrua/111082)

kpszsu reported a jet drone in Sumy district heading southwest, while eRadarrua detected a new "Banderоль" near Putyvl in Sumy oblast, confirming sustained aerial pressure on the northern border. (Source: @kpszsu/76839)

A jet drone was reported in Mykolaiv district heading north by kpszsu, with another tracked toward Izmail from the east, indicating aerial strikes reaching the Odesa Danube delta region. (Source: @kpszsu/76817)

eRadarrua detected a UAV from the sea heading south of Odesa oblast toward Vylkove, a Danube delta town, signaling potential strikes on Ukrainian Danube shipping infrastructure. (Source: @eRadarrua/111087)

kpszsu reported a jet drone heading toward Katlabuh and a loitering munition "Banderоль" heading toward Dnipro from the north, with another jet drone toward Novomykolaivka in Zaporizhzhia oblast from the east, demonstrating multi-vector southern pressure. (Source: @kpszsu/76860)

kpszsu tracked a jet drone in Nikopol district of Dnipro oblast heading northeast, consistent with strike positioning toward the Nikopol-Kryvyi Rih axis opposite the Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant frontline. (Source: @kpszsu/76840)

Russia executed a complex multi-type aerial package across at least nine oblasts overnight, combining "Banderоль" loitering munitions, jet drones, cruise missiles, KAB guided bombs, and threatened ballistic Iskander-M launches from Taganrog and Kursk oblast (including S-300/Zircon variants). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73799)

eRadarrua reported a Tu-95MS redeployment from the Far East to Engels for cruise missile arming, then onward to Olenya, marking the second such flight this week; five more Tu-95MS remain armed in the Far East, with preparation pointing to a massive missile strike likely at week's end. (Source: @eRadarrua/111094)

KAB guided bombs were launched at Kharkiv oblast from across the border, per eRadarrua, while jet drones were tracked past Krasnopavlivka heading to Zlatopil, showing combined manned/unmanned strike coordination on the Kharkiv axis. (Source: @eRadarrua/111087)

Cruise missile threats on Lubny were reported twice by mon1tor_ua, followed by direct impact reports and a downed/damaged jet drone strike on residential houses in the same city, confirming successful penetration of Poltava oblast air defenses. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73786)
A UAV was detected near Znamianka in Kirovohrad oblast, likely reconnaissance, indicating Russian ISR buildup for future strike targeting deep into central Ukraine. (Source: @eRadarrua/111126)

Air raid was declared in Kyiv at 02:22 local time, with sustained loitering munition activity tracked throughout the night toward Brovary, Boryspil, and Vasylkiv districts. (Source: @eRadarrua/111085)

key_developments: Russian forces advanced near Kostiantynivka in Donetsk oblast per DeepStateUA's updated map, indicating continued pressure on a critical Ukrainian logistics hub behind the main line of contact. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23807)

US envoys Witkoff and Kushner held parallel talks with Putin in Moscow and Zelensky in Kyiv on an updated settlement package, with Witkoff claiming significant progress but no concrete agreement. (Source: @tass_agency/394072)

Ukraine struck the Ryazan Oil Refinery (Rosneft, ~17 million tons/year) and the Adler helicopter base in Sochi, reportedly destroying Ka-52 and Mi-28 attack helicopters and damaging an Mi-8, demonstrating deep strike capability. (Source: @eRadarrua/111093)

Russia launched a coordinated multi-type aerial assault combining "Banderоль" loitering munitions, jet drones, cruise missiles, and KAB bombs against nine oblasts, with Lubny suffering direct cruise missile hits on residential areas. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73785)

A Russian attack in Chuhuiv, Kharkiv oblast killed a 19-year-old woman, an 11-year-old boy, and a 45-year-old man and wounded a 40-year-old woman, almost wiping out an entire family. (Source: @UkraineNow/83912)

Threats of Iskander-M ballistic launches from Taganrog (Rostov oblast) and S-300/Zircon from Kursk oblast were issued, while Tu-95MS redeployment to Engels indicates preparation for a massive cruise missile strike likely at week's end. (Source: @eRadarrua/111094)

The Orlovka border checkpoint with Romania in Odessa oblast suspended operations due to attacks on border infrastructure, disrupting a critical western logistics corridor for Ukraine. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33043)
sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting an intensified, multi-axis aerial campaign combining loitering munitions, jet drones, cruise missiles, KAB bombs, and threatened ballistic Iskander-M launches, while simultaneously redeploying strategic Tu-95MS bombers for what appears to be preparation for a massive cruise missile strike at week's end. The Kremlin has publicly signaled to US intermediaries that it will not abandon its military goals, citing battlefield progress and demanding increasingly tough conditions, suggesting Russia views the current negotiating environment from a position of perceived strength. Ukrainian deep-strike capability was demonstrated by successful attacks on the Rosneft-owned Ryazan refinery and the Adler helicopter base in Sochi, though Russian frontline advances near Kostiantynivka indicate continued tactical pressure on Ukrainian defenses in Donetsk oblast.
sections.regional_response: Diplomatic activity intensified with US special envoys Witkoff and Kushner conducting parallel negotiations in Moscow and Kyiv, claiming significant progress on a renewed "peace package," though Zelensky reported Russia denied the US delegation permission to fly directly to Ukrainian airports. Ukrainian MP Kostenko publicly addressed domestic concerns by ruling out forced mobilization of women, framing it as an artificially hyped issue, which suggests internal political pressure on manpower policy. The Orlovka checkpoint closure on the Romanian border signals that western logistics corridors remain vulnerable to Russian strike pressure, potentially affecting Ukraine's ability to absorb western military aid and supplies. Polish and Romanian border infrastructure faces elevated risk as Russia continues demonstrating capability and willingness to strike border-adjacent targets.
sections.intelligence_notes: The pattern of "Banderоль" loitering munition tracks consistently converging on Kyiv region (Brovary, Boryspil, Vasylkiv) from multiple northern vectors suggests deliberate targeting of critical infrastructure in the capital area rather than dispersed strikes. Russian preparation cycle indicators—the Tu-95MS redeployment to Engels, five additional armed bombers in the Far East, and active tactical aviation on the eastern axis—point to a deliberate escalation tempo designed to apply pressure during the US-brokered negotiation window. Ukraine's demonstrated deep-strike reach to Sochi (Adler airport) and Ryazan represents a significant escalation in its ability to target Russian strategic energy and military aviation assets, potentially complicating Russian force sustainment for occupation forces. The Russian strike on the Chuhuiv family reflects continued use of double-tap and indiscriminate tactics in populated areas despite ongoing high-level diplomatic engagement.
